csv_agency: City of Rochester DES Dept Environmental Services
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Rochester seeks professional engineering and design services to prepare a comprehensive mechanical systems master plan for the Rundel Memorial Library. The plan will assess existing conditions, provide a matrix of options for the various mechanical systems, provide recommendations on priority projects and phasing/subphasing to achieve projects within normal City budgetary constraints, and develop phased/subphased conceptual scopes of work with cost estimates and timelines.
